text: The later context-only commit 3726046d7a592b88ecd7aae917f63f8b81ed2301 states the original lookup assertions accidentally passed because null == undefined, then fixes incorrect parent IDs and expected sorted indices. Current tests check missing lookup returns 0 and use explicit numeric expected IDs; moving a subtree also checks a descendant path. For these lookup tests, verify the fixture topology and establish that expected targets exist before equality assertions. The later commit was read as context only; its review and original runtime outcome were not independently checked. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Do not let two missing values validate a malformed lookup fixture
